causes.reason: Latency (z=+9.9) rose only in proportion to its slow cart dependency (which calls cache), with its own CPU, memory, and error rate all normal — a pure victim of the cache slowdown.
causes.verify_note: c4, c11 show checkout abnormal

events.ticket_note: Root cause is a memory leak in the cache service: heap climbed steadily from ~500 to 744 MB (z=+28.9) starting t-10s with 'heap at 70/73/82% after full GC' warnings, normal CPU, and no downstream dependencies; GC pressure spiked cache latency 2→30 ms, which slowed cart (z=+5.1) and checkout (z=+9.9) as downstream victims. Next step: restart/roll cache to restore latency and capture a heap dump to find the leak; separately note payment's +66 MB memory step at t-5s (z=+11.3, still fast) as a follow-up but it is not driving this outage.
events.customer_update: Parts of the shop are running slowly right now — adding items to your cart and checking out may take longer than usual. Everything still works, just more slowly, and our team is already working on a fix.
